youtube_description:
The ULA Network would like to thank Charles Hamilton President of the Association of Benefit Administrators and former Funds Administrator for Local 338 RWDSU/UFCW Affiliated Benefit Funds for sharing his story.  

Charles shared his experience as the former funds administrator for Local 338 RWDSU/UFCW on his experience with PayerMatrix and how their cost savings on specialty drugs has allowed the funds to utilize those savings for better wages and enhanced benefits for the membership. 

For more information on PayerMatrix visit:  www.payermatrix.com 
For more information of Local 338 RWDSU visit:  https://local338.org

The ULA Network would like to thank our sponsors and supporters for believing in our mission to support educate and promote our union labor family and our communities.
